correctness.rationale: The rank-two equivalence invariant follows by induction on one-variable rank-one formulas and realizes distinguishing rank-two sentences. An elementary classification of isolated, extremal and interior points bounds the number of realizable spectra by 20 in every finite poset. Twenty explicit transitive witnesses reach the bound. The code exhaustively enumerates all posets through six points by linear-extension seeds, independently compares all 210 witness pairs and 1000 additional small-poset comparisons in the direct two-round E-F game, and verifies minimal sizes. A direct six-point necessity argument uses two min, two max and two separate internal witnesses for spectrum 232.

value.rationale: A natural model-theoretic classification invariant is determined exactly for all finite pure posets rather than an arbitrary finite instance: twenty possible logical theories at rank two, precise least representative-size distribution and a sharp six-element global compression cutoff. The structural classification of extrema and incomparability explains every permitted case, making the invariant reusable in finite-model equivalence and bounded-rank compression.
